description: Copilot CLI wiring for the Windows-only Power BI Desktop hook. Copilot has no `if` field, so the script re-checks the command itself.

PostToolUse.bash: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/desktop-hooks.sh" ] || { echo 'pbi-desktop hooks are OFF: desktop-hooks.sh is missing.' >&2; exit 0; }; bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/desktop-hooks.sh" post; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; exit 0
PostToolUse.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; try { & "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run-hook.ps1" desktop-hooks.sh post; exit $LASTEXITCODE } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('pbi-desktop hooks are OFF: ' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 0 }
